name: CLARITY / Senate digital asset market structure text
effective_state_note: The Senate cloture vote on the motion to proceed failed 49 to 50 on 15 September 2026, eleven short of the 60 required. The Senate never reached debate, so no vote was taken on the bill's contents. STALLED is a statement about procedure, not about the merits, and not a prediction.

verification.note: The vote count and date come from press reporting, not from a Senate roll-call record we retrieved ourselves. Anything published from this row must say so until the roll call is fetched.

goals_touched.what_the_source_raises: allocation of digital assets between securities and digital commodities
allocation of responsibility between the SEC and the CFTC

why_still_indexed_though_stalled: The goals this text raises did not vanish with the vote. Three other sources in this crosswalk address the same goals and remain operative. That is the whole reason the crosswalk is anchored to goals rather than to section numbers.
